visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a maroon t-shirt and black pants stands in a modern indoor hallway, performing complex yo-yo maneuvers with a red yo-yo and yellow string. Beside him, a man in a white Supreme hoodie and a black cap watches with his hands on his hips. The background features wooden paneling and a display case with various figurines. (2) The scene shifts to a woman in a white off-the-shoulder top and a black ruffled skirt who is now performing a yo-yo trick. She manipulates the yellow string into the shape of a banana. The man in the white hoodie watches closely, his expression shifting from neutral to extreme shock. (3) The man in the white hoodie reacts dramatically to the woman's trick, placing his hands on his face and then pulling his cap down in disbelief as he leans toward the camera. Bright, even indoor lighting illuminates the corridor.

(3) Following the exclamation, a male voice reacts with a series of high-arousal shouts: 'Nice!', 'Amazing!', 'OMG!', and 'How did you do that?'. The tone is intensely surprised and energetic, synchronized with the rhythmic BGM which maintains its upbeat tempo throughout.
